content: Rainy-day plan for the charity sale: Move all stalls indoors into the activity room, set up 5–6 tables along the walls, and keep the center aisle clear. Place non-slip mats and an umbrella bucket at the entrance. The stall team should use compact displays, and the cashier desk should move to an inner corner. Add two people at the entrance for crowd control, and have the cleaning team dry the floor promptly. If it gets crowded, admit people in batches. Keep wet items away from power sources, and inspect and restore the room before finishing.<|boundary:CONTINUE|>
